# f5xc_cloud_link (Data Source)

CloudLink is used to establish private connectivity from customer network to Cloud Sites or private connectivity from<br>F5 XC Regional Edge(RE) to customer Cloud Sites

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Cloud Link - Full

data "f5xc_cloud_link" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_cloud_link.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_cloud_link.example.namespace
}
```
